purpose: Observe actual workout, not a fifth fix
hookScope: bounded120-second weak-scene sampler every1second including current cached selection
lifecycleIdentity: Per-scene UUID plus per-view UUID and concrete content root/entity identities. Sampler map uses weak scene references.
behaviorMutations: No material, transform, camera, selection, cache, plan or package changes. Only diagnostic state and file writes.
diagnosticEnvironment: Enable only after Pro baseline freeze; DEBUG plus HANGTEN_REVIEW_HIGHLIGHT_DIAGNOSTIC=1. HANGTEN_REVIEW_DIAGNOSTIC_RUN must include workspace owner.
limits: Uncompiled scratch proposal; API typechecking requires root build gate.
Off-body sampling/direct file I/O and extra DEBUG state may alter timing; successful run does not demonstrate fix.
Output is direct newline-complete FileHandle writes, unique file per recorder; sample-end/view-disappear synchronizes. Missing closing event means capture lifetime incomplete.
duplicateSuppression: No cached-noop events; unchanged view-update signatures suppressed before full entity snapshots. 1Hz samples preserve material/cache observations.
disabledOverhead: Cached static DEBUG gate skips recorder creation, content-root array creation and diagnostic UUID reads in callbacks when disabled.
